# openEHR Go SDK

> Cadasto's Go SDK for openEHR. It covers the openEHR REST API, the Reference
> Model as typed Go structs, building and validating Compositions from
> operational templates, AQL, and SMART-on-openEHR authentication. The
> building-block packages (RM, codecs, validation, templates, AQL) import
> without the HTTP client or auth.

openEHR is an open specification for an electronic health record. Clinical
content is modelled on two levels: the
[Reference Model](https://specifications.openehr.org/releases/RM/development/ehr.html)
plus archetypes that constrain it. Platform operations are in the
[Service Model](https://specifications.openehr.org/releases/SM/development/openehr_platform.html).
This SDK is a Go client for that platform's REST binding,
[ITS-REST](https://specifications.openehr.org/releases/ITS-REST/Release-1.1.0/).
Its typed clients are written against the Release-1.1.0 OpenAPI files vendored
in the repository, so any clinical data repository (CDR) implementing them is a
target. Live probes are opt-in and can point at EHRbase
(`OPENEHR_LIVE_EHRBASE`) or FerroEHR (`OPENEHR_LIVE_FERROEHR`); the
per-deployment notes are on Workflow.

Cadasto B.V. writes this SDK. The `cadasto/` packages ship in the same module
but are not part of the openEHR REST contract; Packages lists them and their
maturity.

The module path is `github.com/cadasto/openehr-sdk-go`, and it requires Go
1.27 or newer. The SDK is pre-1.0: pin an exact tag. The specification in the
repository is the source of truth, so when code and a specification disagree,
the specification wins. MIT-licensed, developed by Cadasto B.V.

Runnable programs live under `cmd/examples/` and work offline.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/): the landing page: what
  openEHR is, what the SDK covers, and the quick start.
- [Install](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/install/): `go get`, the
  Go 1.27 requirement, and the choice between the building-block packages and
  the REST client.
- [Workflow](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/workflow/): Where the
  SDK sits between a modelling tool and a CDR, and which deployments it has
  been run against.
- [Examples](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/examples/): Showcase
  programs and the full `cmd/examples/` catalogue.
- [Packages](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/packages/): Import map
  for the building blocks, the REST client, auth, sandbox, and the Cadasto
  extras.
- [Go reference](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/reference/):
  Redirects to the generated API on
  [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/cadasto/openehr-sdk-go).
- [Contributing](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/contributing/):
  `make ci`, the specification-driven loop, and the docs-site targets.
- [Contact](https://cadasto.github.io/openehr-sdk-go/contact/): Cadasto B.V.
  email, the reseller sales route, and registered details.
